{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Kaz}} {{MultipleIssues|expand|image}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:CintaKaz-AndorS2.png]] |name=Cinta Kaz |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[3 BBY]], [[Ghorman]]"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the second three episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 2|Season 2]], including the [[death]] of Cinta Kaz on [[Ghorman]] in "[[What a Festive Evening]]," to [[3 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]]{{ThisWeek|B2CRRJ_Wql4|Andor and the Eye, Galactic Pals Returns, and More!|sw_url=video/andor-and-the-eye-galactic-pals-returns-and-more}} |pronouns=She/her{{Databank|cinta-kaz|Cinta Kaz}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families=[[Cinta Kaz's family]]{{Andor|The Eye}} |parents=new |partners=[[Vel Sartha]] |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Axis network]] **[[Aldhani rebel infiltration team]] |masters= |apprentices= |option1=3 BBY|image2=[[File:CintaKaz-OWO.png]]|option2=5 BBY}} {{Quote|She was a miracle.|Vel Sartha about Cinta Kaz|{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}}} '''Cinta Kaz''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was a member of the rebel [[Axis network|network]] operated by [[Luthen Rael]] in resistance to the [[Galactic Empire]]. At some point, Kaz's entire [[Cinta Kaz's family|family]] was [[Death|killed]] by [[stormtrooper]]s. Kaz became a member of a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|team]] that fellow rebel, and Kaz's eventual lover, [[Vel Sartha]] led on a [[Aldhani heist|mission]] to break into the armory of the [[Aldhani Garrison|garrison]] on [[Aldhani]] and steal an Imperial [[sector]]'s quarterly payroll of more than 80 million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. Another member of that team, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], had been recruited by Rael within [[Standard day|days]] of the mission. During the mission, Kaz [[Blaster|shot]] the Imperial [[Colonel]] [[Soden Petigar]] and held [[Commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]]'s [[Roboda Beehaz|wife]] and [[Leonart Beehaz|son]] hostage to force his cooperation. Although the theft was successful, the only survivors of the mission were Kaz, Sartha, and Andor. When Andor became a loose end who could reveal too much if the Empire captured him, Kaz was tasked with killing him and went to [[Ferrix]], his adopted [[homeworld]]. She rented a room where she awaited his return while he was incarcerated on [[Narkina 5]], and she eventually took a job at [[Nicola's]] [[Restaurant|café]] to keep watch on his [[Andor household|family home]] and his [[Parent|adoptive mother]], [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]]. On Kaz's behalf, Sartha relayed a message for Rael that Maarva had died. Though Cassian came during the [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]], he evaded detection by Kaz as well as the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] agents that had hoped to capture him. As Kaz exited from an ensuing [[Ferrix Riot|riot]], she stabbed [[ISB Attendant]] [[Corv]], then packed up her room with Sartha's assistance. In [[4 BBY]], Kaz escorted [[Tay Kolma]] from the [[wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma]] and assassinated him shortly after. A year later, Kaz and Sartha worked with members of the [[Ghorman Front]] as Imperial subjugation of the [[planet]]'s [[Ghorman (people)|people]] escalated. During the [[Ghorman heist|mission]], [[Samm]] got in fight with [[Lezine]]. Samm's [[blaster]] fired, unintentionally hitting Kaz, killing her. ==Biography== ===Preparations=== {{Quote|A blaster burn. It needs to be cleaned. Apologies in advance. It's going to hurt. We're trying to save our pain meds.|Cinta Kaz, to the wounded Cassian Andor|}} Cinta Kaz was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] whose entire [[Cinta Kaz's family|family]] had been [[Death|killed]] by [[stormtrooper]]s. At some [[time]], she became romantic partners with [[Vel Sartha]],{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} a [[Chandrilan]] woman who had a privileged upbringing and was the [[Mothma family|cousin]] of [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]].{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} Kaz and Sartha were both part of a rebel [[Axis network|network]] operated by [[Luthen Rael]]. In [[5 BBY]],The [[Aldhani (episode)|episode]] in which Cinta Kaz first appears is set in the same time frame as "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which is dated to [[5 BBY]]. she was part of a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel team]] led by Sartha. The team's [[Aldhani heist|mission]] was stealing the quarterly payroll of an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[sector]] by breaking into the armory of the [[Aldhani Garrison]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]]. Kaz would eventually learn that her companion [[Taramyn Barcona]] was a former stormtrooper, but she was able to cooperate with him nonetheless. A complication arose three [[Standard day|days]] before the heist when Rael delivered [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] to Sartha and demanded that she add him to the group for redundancy. Kaz and her companions were skeptical when Sartha brought Andor to [[Vel Sartha's camp|their camp]], but they began bringing him up to speed with their plans. Using her [[medic]]al skills, Kaz treated a [[blaster]] burn on Andor's arm. [[File:TheAxeForgets-AndorS1E5.png|thumb|right|300px|Cinta Kaz and Vel Sartha see a threat.]] The next morning, [[Arvel Skeen]] shared his impressions of Kaz with Andor, and he added that Kaz was already sharing a blanket as she and Sartha exited a hut together. When Taramyn Barcona drilled Andor, Skeen, and [[Karis Nemik]] on marching in formation, Kaz spotted an approaching [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] and raised the warning, giving the team enough time to hide their weapons before the [[starfighter]] flew over them. Afterward, as the group packed up their camp, Kaz quizzed Andor on the [[Aldhani (language)|Aldhani]] phrases he had learned thus far from the [[datapad]] supplied by Barcona. When Kaz learned that Sartha already knew and had not told her that Andor was a [[mercenary]], Kaz was displeased. Around the campfire that evening, the group passed around a canteen. When Andor held it out to Kaz, Sartha stepped between them, intercepted it, and drank a toast to the rebellion. The team then split in two for their separate objectives; Sartha and Kaz left together. ===The heist=== {{Quote|Tell me you'll be all right.''"
"''I'll be fine. Go.|Vel Sartha and Cinta Kaz|}} Andor, Barcona, Nemik, and Skeen entered the garrison disguised in [[Imperial military uniforms]], but Kaz and Sartha used stealth to approach from behind the [[Aldhani dam]]. They first hid within a stone overhang along the reservoir's edge as they confirmed radio contact with the other team. Kaz quickly silenced Sartha when she realized several patrolling soldiers were approaching their hideout; Sartha stopped Kaz from drawing her blaster pistol on them. Under the cover of the [[Eye of Aldhani]] event, they dove into the water and then climbed a ladder on the dam's wall. Sartha placed scrambling equipment that they would use to disrupt Imperial communications. When the time came to confirm to Barcona via radio that the mission would proceed, Sartha initially froze while Kaz urged her to stop stalling and respond in the affirmative. They descended on cables from the top of the dam. [[File:CintaKazGoodbye-TheEye.png|thumb|left|275px|Kaz bids Vel Sartha an emotional goodbye]] In the tower base room, the infiltration group captured a guard, [[Commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]], his [[Roboda Beehaz|wife]], and his [[Leonart Beehaz|young son]], along with the visiting [[Colonel]] [[Soden Petigar|Petigar]], who threatened to shoot Nemik if the team did not release the child. Kaz ended the standoff upon her arrival by shooting and killing Petigar. She then held her blaster rifle to the child's head as Beehaz was forced to cooperate. The hostages, bound and gagged, were brought up to the observation tower. Nemik reviewed various functions on the control panels with Kaz before she took charge of the hostages while the rest of the team carried out the theft. Before they parted, Sartha held Kaz's hand and asked for assurance that Kaz would be all right; Kaz answered that she would. During the next [[Standard minute|minutes]], Nemik commed Kaz to confirm the team made it to the freighter and that the [[Alkenzi Air Base]] was expected to make contact soon. She had just dressed herself in one of the garrison's uniforms when the call came through from Alkenzi wing command. After checking the time, she turned off the facility's lights while the hostages looked on. She exited in disguise to approach the [[Nasma Brani]], a sacred temple{{Databank|dhani|Dhani}} where the [[Dhani]] pilgrims and their Imperial escorts were viewing the Eye. ===Assignment on Ferrix=== {{Quote|Haven't we been apart long enough?''"
"''It's not about us.''"
"''After what we've been through?''"
"''You think the Empire stops to catch its breath? This is a fight to the death, Vel.|Vel Sartha and Cinta Kaz|{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}}} [[File:Vel_and_cinta_ferrix.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Cinta Kaz and Vel Sartha reunite on Ferrix.]] In response to the heist, the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] launched an investigation and arrested many of the Dhani residents. Kaz was preparing to ride a [[speeder bike]] when an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] flew over the sacred valley. Sartha initially journeyed to [[Coruscant]] while Kaz embarked on their new assignment: kill Cassian Andor to silence him.{{Andor|Announcement}} The couple reunited on Andor's adopted [[homeworld]], [[Ferrix]], where Andor's adoptive [[Parent|mother]], [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], lived in the [[Andor household|family residence]]. From [[Nicola's]], a [[Restaurant|café]] across the street, Sartha observed the home and two of Andor's friends, [[Bix Caleen]] and [[Brasso]], while waiting for Kaz to rejoin her. Kaz's drink had gone [[Temperature|cold]] in the meantime, but she had located a nearby room available for rent. Although Sartha thought they could not stay, Kaz said that she herself could; one would draw less attention than two. Sartha was hurt at the idea of being separated from each other again, but Kaz was adamant that the Empire did not rest and that it was not about them. When Sartha questioned who Kaz would pretend to be, Kaz made a pointed remark about being a rich girl running away from her [[Mothma family|family]], reflecting Sartha's own situation. Taking Sartha's hand, Kaz reminded her girlfriend that they had begun their relationship knowing the struggle would always come first for her. Kaz remained on Ferrix to continue watching and waiting for news of Andor while monitoring Imperial movements at [[Hotel Rix]] seized as the [[Ferrix garrison]]'s headquarters. She surveilled the hotel with a camera and [[electrobinoculars]] kept in her rented room{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} and blended in among the locals.{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} An [[ISB Attendant|attendant]] for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB), [[Corv]], also pretended to be a civilian, which Kaz noticed.{{Andor|One Way Out}} Aware that he was ISB, she kept a close eye on him from her roomand when he visited Nicola's, which they both used to observe the Andor home. She took a job there in the [[Standard week|week]] before Maarva Andor's [[death]]. When Andor died, Kaz notified Sartha, who in turn relayed the information to [[Kleya Marki]], Rael's partner in [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|business]] and rebellion. Cassian's mother's [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]] was expected to draw him back home. Although Kaz intended to pick Sartha up upon arrival on the planet, [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] had also arrived and walked the city with Corv as her guide. In Kaz's rush to follow them, she was unsure if she had left her room locked; Sartha let herself in to wait for her. The movements from the Imperials signaled that they were also anticipating Andor. Kaz still had a hard focus on the mission, but when Sartha asked her to come away from the window, she softened and did so. As the time of the [[funeral]] neared, Kaz kept watch on Maarva Andor's home while Sartha met with Luthen Rael and informed him of Kaz's observations. With the Imperials expected to bring Cassian Andor to the hotel if captured, Rael wanted Kaz positioned there instead. The funeral became a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]], and people fled from it. Kaz tailed Corv through the crowd, but when he spotted and recognized her, she moved back into a doorway and let him get close enough to stab him through his rib cage, then closed the door to hide where he had fallen. Afterwards, she returned to her room to pack up her surveillance equipment with Sartha. Sartha was concerned that Corv's [[blood]] on Kaz's hand was an injury; after Kaz said it was not her own, they resumed packing. ===Assignment on Chandrila=== {{Quote|Tay Kolma?"
"Yes."
"I wasn't sure."
"Where's Otto?"
"I don't know. I was just called to fill in.|Cinta Kaz and Tay Kolma|}} [[File:KazKolmaChandrila-Harvest.png|thumb|left|250px|Cinta acknowledges a shocked Vel as she leaves with Tay Kolma]] By [[4 BBY]],{{Andor|One Year Later}} dates the first arc of [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' 2]] to [[4 BBY]]. Kaz had been out of contact with Sartha for some time due to an assignment from Luthen Rael. On the second day of Sartha's niece [[Leida Mothma|Leida]]'s wedding, Vel confided to Mon Mothma that if she wanted to, Cinta was capable of contacting her, admitting that the relationship Kaz and Sartha shared was never going to be perfect.{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} The next day, Kaz took over as driver for Mothma's old friend [[Tay Kolma]] as he left the festivities early. Sartha was on the landing platform and exchanged glances with Kaz before the latter departed with Kolma;{{Andor|Harvest}} in reality, Kaz had been called by Rael to ensure Kolma would no longer be a problem, as he had attempted to blackmail Mothma.{{SW|url=news/andor-explained-season-2-highlights-episodes-1-2-3|text=''Andor'' Explained: Episodes 1-3 - "One Year Later", "Sagrona Teema", and "Harvest"}} ===Assignment on Ghorman=== Kaz was soon involved in an accident on a mission which harmed her both mentally and physically. She was left unable to properly function, and blamed herself for choosing the assignment whilst not in the correct headspace. Throughout the year, Kaz thought consistently about Sartha and regretted how their relationship seemingly ended. In [[3 BBY]], Kaz was offered an assignment on [[Ghorman]], which she accepted after learning Sartha would also be there. [[File:AndorWhatAFestiveEvening Vel Cinta.png|thumb|right|250px|Cinta Kaz reunited with Vel Sartha after a year apart]] Kaz arrived on Ghorman and headed to the Caf House, where Sartha was already positioned. Sartha complimented Kaz's new hairstyle and Kaz asked her about the arrival and where her gear was stashed. They discussed the seemingly unprepared nature of the [[Ghorman Front]], with Sartha admitting that she only accepted the assignment on the condition Kaz was also there. Kaz revealed her similar motivation, as well as her accident, although she was reluctant to share any details. Kaz agreed to tell Sartha what happened after the mission ended, as well as disclosing her continued thoughts of Sartha during her recovery. At the [[Ghorman Front Headquarters]], Sartha and Kaz met with those who were a part of the operation. Kaz watched as Sartha ran over the rules of the plan and what was intended of the rebel members. Kaz defended Sartha when the getaway driver [[Dreena]], was reluctant to follow Sartha's orders. Sartha ordered that everyone apart from herself and Kaz had to be unarmed. Kaz and Sartha retreated to a private room to discuss the mission. Sartha stated they could walk away, whilst Kaz was more concerned about Dreena possibly disobeying orders. Kaz apologized to Sartha for not contacting her, and stated she was confused, as well as not thinking right when she accepted the mission. Sartha was upset at Rael for never notifying her about Kaz's condition, and having endangered Kaz in the first place. Kaz stated that they were worth more to Rael separately than together, but Sartha stated they would have to speak to him about it. Emotionally moved, Kaz romantically embraced Sartha. Unfortunately, thanks to the intelligence provided by Imperial loyalist [[Syril Karn]], the Ghorman rebels were unknowingly playing a part orchestrated by [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] lieutenant [[Dedra Meero]] and her superior Major [[Lio Partagaz]]. The heist was a fabrication, and the rebels were monitored by Karn while they successfully secured the carrier. Kaz and Sartha considered ending the message early, before they decided they had time, and Kaz headed to sort the fuses. Young rebel [[Samm]] disobeyed orders and brought a blaster, then got into an argument with passer-by [[Lezine]] and Samm accidentally fired his blaster, which hit Kaz and killed her instantly. ===Legacy=== [[File:LezineCarryingCinta-FestiveEvening.jpg|thumb|250px|Lezine carries Cinta's corpse to safety]] Sartha was distraught over Kaz's death, and angrily confronted Samm over his role in the death. She stated he would carry her memory with him forever as he cried and apologized. Samm became an established member of the Front, who aided [[Wilmon Paak]] and Andor during the [[Ghorman Massacre]].{{Andor|Who Are You?}} In [[1 BBY]], Andor toasted in her memory when Sartha visited him.{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Then there's Cinta. Cinta Kaz. She's stone cold and fearless. Probably the toughest one here. She's already sharin' a blanket, if that's what you're wonderin'.|Arvel Skeen to Cassian Andor|}} Cinta Kaz had long [[Color|black]] [[hair]], dark skin, and brown [[eye]]s. At the [[time]] of the Aldhani mission, she was around mid-twenties in age.{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} Vel Sartha and Arvel Skeen both described her as cold; the latter also regarded her as tough and fearless. In her relationship with Sartha, while Sartha sought assurances regarding Kaz's well-being and found time apart to be difficult, Kaz considered it necessary and prioritized the rebellion over her personal life and relationships. However, she was willing to break her intense focus when Sartha expressed vulnerability to her. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|How's your arm?''"
"''It's good. You're a healer.|Cinta Kaz and Cassian Andor|}} Kaz had medical skills that included cleaning and dressing wounds and she had sufficient knowledge of the Aldhani language to drill others. She was proficient with blasters and at diving and abseiling. ==Equipment== During her assignments, Kaz dressed to blend in with residents. On Aldhani, she wore the fleece-lined garb of a shepherd until the heist began; then, she used practical equipment that included a wetsuit while diving and an Imperial uniform as a disguise. While on Ferrix, Kaz dressed in a green, quilted shirt and other local attire and carried a knife that she could easily conceal. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|She was written as someone who doesn't speak a lot, but when she does, she holds a presence. I think Vel […] was described in the script as someone who is physically powerful and commanding, and Cinta is the one who looks meek, and may not be capable of violence. So it's a shock when people see her in action, which also ties into the ideology of women slipping under the radar.|Varada Sethu on portraying Cinta Kaz|{{WebCite|url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/interview-with-kerala-born-british-indian-star-wars-actor-varada-sethu/article66139458.ece|text=Kerala-born British actor Varada Sethu on playing a rebel in 'Star Wars' show 'Andor'|author=Aswin, V. N.|date=2022-11-22|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hindu|''The Hindu'']]|archivedate=20221126023757}}}} [[File:Andor_-_Cinta_Kaz_Poster.png|thumb|right|200px|Character poster of Cinta Kaz]] Cinta Kaz was portrayed by [[Varada Sethu]] and debuted in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' and the start of a three-episode arc directed by [[Susanna White]]. Writer [[Tony Gilroy]] said no one at [[Lucasfilm]] was against Kaz and Vel Sartha's relationship, though no one told him to include it. Gilroy did not want the relationship to be performative in any way.{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/star-wars-andor-same-sex-couple-revolution-tony-gilroy-1235428948|text=Sex and Revolution: ‘Andor' Showrunner Tony Gilroy on Challenging the Limits of the 'Star Wars' Universe|author=Vary, Adam B|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20221110170441}} The [[2023 Topps Star Wars|2023 ''Topps Star Wars'']] card for Kaz stated her homeworld was Aldhani,{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=Cinta Kaz|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170390/2023-Topps-Star-Wars-60-Cinta-Kaz}} which [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed was a mistake.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1693067125491912721|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-08-19|quote=They're not. I doubt they'd call it home either. It sounds like a poor choice of description of a planet they happen to be associated with. {{C|In response to: Hey @pabl0hidalgo @missingwords, in the spirit of recent card game discussion, topps recently dropped a new set but I think these homeworlds don't add up? I guess it's not impossible but I never got a sense all were from aldhani}}|archivedate=20230820012834}} In an interview with [[Wikipedia:The Hindu|''The Hindu'']], Sethu described how the actors portraying the rebel team prepared by reading books and watching documentaries recommended by White about real-life rebellions and conflicts. Eileen MacDonald's [[Wikipedia:Shoot the Women First|''Shoot the Women First'']] inspired aspects of Cinta and how Sethu portrayed her; it described how women who say little and do not appear physically powerful may slip under the radar before violent action. Based on the line about stormtroopers slaughtering Cinta's family, Sethu imagined the character might have survived a genocide. Scenes on Aldhani were filmed at the [[Wikipedia:Cruachan Power Station|Cruachan Dam]] and the surrounding mountains in the [[Wikipedia:Scottish Highlands|Scottish Highlands]].{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|date=2022-08-04}} According to [[Faye Marsay]], Sartha's actress, the scenes were filmed during the middle of the [[Wikipedia:COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/1082395/andors-faye-marsay-talks-preparing-to-play-vel-sartha-the-real-rebellions-that-inspired-her-more-exclusive-interview|date=2022-11-02|text=Andor's
